name: task_cancel
description: Cancel one or more still-running asynchronously spawned subagent tasks (from task_spawn). Preflights the whole batch: if any active task has live progress within the last 60 seconds, rejects the call and cancels nothing unless force is true. Check task_status and keep waiting while progress advances. Use force only for superseded or no-longer-needed work, never to shorten a wait. Terminates the subagent process and fills its result slot with a 'cancelled' terminal result carrying cancel_reason separately from error and preserving available partial output. Collect that result with task_wait or task_status before integration and resource cleanup.

task_ids.description: Array of async subagent task ids (from task_spawn) to cancel.

reason.description: Optional reason for canceling these tasks.

force.description: Bypass the recent-progress guard only when work is superseded or no longer needed. Never use force to shorten a wait. Without force, one active task with progress less than 60 seconds old rejects the entire batch.
